global_style: Neo-noir, high-contrast chiaroscuro, dramatic low angles and tight close-ups; motivated warm golden practical against deep, cool shadows; cinematic suspense with minimalist framing.

project_settings.location_lock: Shadowy interior room (urban apartment or warehouse), modern city, strictly indoors (NOT outdoors, NOT Mediterranean villa, NOT suburban living room)
negative_constraints: Vintage tech (CRT TVs, rotary phones, typewriters, payphones)
Futuristic tech (holograms, AR UI, biometric scanners, LED matrix lighting)
Bright, high-key or flat lighting; white fluorescent overheads
Exterior views (windows showing daylight, city skyline, palm trees)
Religious or supernatural depictions inside the briefcase (angels, demons, skulls, cosmic portals)
Text or symbols that explain or reveal the briefcase's contents
Explicit references to specific films or characters (Pulp Fiction, Jules, Vincent Vega, Marcellus Wallace)
Obvious product logos or brand placements
Smartphones, laptops, modern screens visible in frame
Police sirens or flashing red/blue lights

style_overrides.color_palette: Deep blacks and cool desaturated shadows contrasted with an intense warm golden glow
style_overrides.lighting_style: Low-key, high-contrast chiaroscuro; single warm source motivated by the briefcase; rapid falloff into darkness
style_overrides.architecture: Industrial urban interior (concrete/brick, minimal ornamentation), timeless and contemporary
style_overrides.set_design: Sparse, worn, utilitarian room; clutter minimal; no visible windows or windows blacked out
style_overrides.props_style: Sleek black hard-shell briefcase with mechanical combination dials (6-6-6); neutral modern furnishings
style_overrides.wardrobe: Contemporary dark suit in matte fabrics; no vintage silhouettes or flashy patterns
style_overrides.camera_language: Extreme low angle and tight close-ups; slow push-in; shallow depth of field
style_overrides.mood_tone: Mysterious, tense, hypnotic crime-noir with visual contrast and suspense
style_overrides.vfx_style: Subtle volumetric warm glow from the case; contents never shown; no exaggerated beams or particles beyond gentle haze

project_settings.era_lock: Contemporary modern era (1990s–2020s), timeless urban crime-noir

key_events: Extreme low angle in a shadowy room frames Vincent over a briefcase.
Vincent turns the combination dials to 6-6-6 and unlocks the case.
Lid opens; intense warm golden light spills out, piercing the darkness.
Vincent's face is bathed in the glow; he stares, mesmerized.
Still entranced, Vincent replies, "Yeah... we happy."
narrative_context.cultural_context: Noir/crime overtones with an enigmatic MacGuffin briefcase; emphasis on visual contrast and suspense.

characters.name: Vincent
characters.description: Sharp-featured man in a tailored black suit, cigarette at his lips; face lit by warm golden glow against deep shadows.
characters.clothing_style: Sharp black suit, crisp white shirt, slim black tie; unlit cigarette.
characters.personality: Cool, composed, curious; mesmerized by mystery.
characters.backstory: Unspecified; appears connected to clandestine dealings.
characters.current_motivation: Open the briefcase and assess its contents; confirm satisfaction to the unseen partner.

characters.name: Off-Screen Voice
characters.description: Unseen presence; only a voice, authoritative and close, cutting through silence.
characters.voice_description: Confident, clipped delivery; interrogative tone; close-mic presence.
characters.current_motivation: Verify success and assert control over the situation.

locations.narrative_function: Concealment and revelation; a tense space focused on the briefcase.
